drafts.body:
## Decision
Use PostgreSQL as the primary database
Source: slack:#eng/1709

## Evidence
- Deployment service db uses a mongodb image; decision selects postgresql. Runtime availability is not checked. (compose.yml:3)
- api.DATABASE_URL configures mongodb; decision selects postgresql. Credentials and host omitted. (compose.yml:6)

## Affected work
- Use SQLAlchemy as the ORM — owner: maya
- Reporting queries rely on Postgres window functions — owner: li

## Next steps
- Confirm which configuration applies.
- Record a replacement decision if appropriate.
- Review each dependent decision with its owner.
- Recheck after updating the code.
